scenario.summary: As the new account, adds a simple product, a configurable variant, a bundle and a grouped product (quantity 5 each), checks out with a new shipping address, Custom Flat Rate and COD (or the centralized-login path) and reads the order number.
steps: Search the simple SKU, quantity 5, Add to Cart
Search the configurable parent, pick variant z-2510001, quantity 5, Add to Cart
Search the bundle SKU, quantity 5, Add to Cart
Search the grouped SKU, child quantity 5, Add to Cart
View cart and checkout, enter shipping address row ValidInput, accept recommended address
Custom Flat Rate; COD (centralizedLoginEnabled=no) or orderPlaceCoverageEnhancement (yes); Complete Purchase
Verify and read the order number
stateChanges: Order placed by the test (created-by-test, not deleted)
evidence: Class: 20 methods, 17 enabled=false and not mapped (returnOrderSaveTheReturnOrderAsDraft, returnOrderVerifyLineItemNotPresentAfterReturning, returnOrderVerifySavedOrderStatus, returnOrderVerifyReturnIconVisibleOnDashboardPanel, returnOrderVerifyReturnIconLinkNavigation, returnOrderVerifyDashboardReturnOrderViewButtonNavigation, returnOrderVerifyDashboardCreateReturnButtonNavigation, returnOrderVerifyDashboardEditReturnOrderLinkNavigation, returnOrderVerifyCancelButtonNavigation, returnOrderVerifyReturnQuantityErrorMessage, returnOrderVerifyReturnOrderTotalPriceCalculations, returnOrderSubmitOrderForReturnAndVerifyThankYouPage, returnOrderVerifyReturnOrderLinkNavigation, returnOrderVerifyReturnActionLinkNavigationOnOrderHistoryPage, returnOrderVerifyInvalidInputsInReturnQuantityTextbox, returnOrderVerifyQuantityReducingAfterPartiallyReturningLineItems, returnOrderVerifyIncludedQuantiiesDisplayingForEachBundleProductChild). Enabled: returnOrderCreateAnAccount -> returnOrderPlaceOrderWithAllProductTypes (dependsOn), returnOrderLogOffTheUser (priority). The session is the account returnOrderCreateAnAccount registers (created-by-test): no declared account.

Products (sheet columns, tda rows): simple z-2420004 'Black + Decker 2.4 Amp Corded 5 in Random Orbit Sander' (Simple, DontTrackInventory; column AddonCheckboxAsOptional, the optional add-on is not selected) -> PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 5, minMaxQuantity 5}, as the approved Selenium shoppingCart entry; configurable B-100000 with variant z-2510001 (picked by selectConfigurableAttributes from the variant's attribute columns, not scanned -> variant1Attr1..3) -> PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_WITH_VARIANTS {quantityUsed 5, minVariants 1, minAddOns 0, minPersonalizableAttributes 0, variantAttributes BulbSize,Color,Technology} (outputs parentProductSku, variant1Sku, variant1Name); each preferred its sheet SKU (not required). Quantities 5 -> config.

bundle: z-1234579 (column DeWalt) -> PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 5, minAddOns 0, minPersonalizableAttributes 0}; grouped: z-2200003 (column VacuumPump) -> PRODUCT_GROUPED_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 5, 0, 0}; each preferred its sheet SKU (not required). These keys have no maximum-quantity param.
shippingAddressDetails/* (masked) is the address the test types onto its own new account -> created-by-test; 'ValidInput' literal -> config.

shipping/payment: checkout selects Custom Flat Rate (shippingMethod.select/clickCustomFlatRateShipping, code FLAT) and Charge on Delivery (paymentMethod.clickCODPaymentOption) -> read-only precondition needs SHIPPING_FLAT_RATE_ON_STORE {FLAT, countries us (assumption, as the approved Playwright order-receipt entries)} and PAYMENT_COD_ON_STORE.
The enabled methods stop at the order receipt (the return steps are in disabled methods), so Create Return eligibility does not matter here.
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder/plp/home entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-11) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map keys, delays, regex) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap / getHashMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
No returnsStore need: the baseline 2026-11-11 (no agents) passes this test, so it does not depend on the store's EnableReturnRequest setting (coordinator decision 2026-11-11).
